scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Let’s go to Yoshinoya. It’s cheap, fast, and their beef bowls are delicious.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yoshinoya, huh... It is convenient, I guess.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: They entered Yoshinoya, took their seats, and ordered beef bowls.

scenarios.speaker: UeD
scenarios.text: Hey! {{playerName}}-kun and Megumi-chan! What a coincidence~

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: UeD-san! Good evening.

scenarios.speaker: UeD
scenarios.text: Megumi-chaaaan, are you making progress on your research? Let’s go present at a conference in Macau together~♪

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Macau!? That sounds amazing. I’ll work hard on my research so I can go!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: As expected of UeD-san, a PhD student… So dedicated to his research. I admire that.

scenarios.speaker: UeD
scenarios.text: Alright, tonight’s meal is on me! I’ll treat both of you~

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: As the three of them enjoyed their meal, UeD-san suddenly looked pale while checking his phone.

scenarios.speaker: UeD
scenarios.text: Oh no! My final job interview was scheduled for this time!!

scenarios.speaker: UeD
scenarios.text: Sorry! I’ve gotta run! I already paid for the meal!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: UeD-san dashed out of Yoshinoya in a panic. In the end, the meal was on him.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: He looked really panicked... I hope he makes it to his interview in time.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Yeah... Well, let’s shift gears and continue our conversation.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Sure♪ By the way, about that trip we were talking about earlier... Where would you like to go, {{playerName}}-senpai?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Where would you like to travel to?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yay♪ It’s a promise! I’ll definitely win the M1GP and go on that trip with you, {{playerName}}-senpai!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: She looks so happy... I need to give it my all and support her the best I can.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Absolutely. It’s a promise! As your mentor, I’ll support you all the way to victory.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you♪ With you by my side, {{playerName}}-senpai, I know we can make a great app!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Despite the chaos caused by UeD-san, the evening brought Megumi and {{playerName}} closer. With a new goal—winning the M1GP and going on their promised trip—their bond continues to deepen...

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Time passes... and the day of the lab trip and M1GP presentation finally arrives.
